source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As the step of declaring battle formations begins, this unit can join another unit of yours that a **CRYPTEK** model is leading. A unit can take at most one **CRYPTOTHRALLS** unit.

If this unit joins, each of its models belongs to that Bodyguard unit for the rest of the battle, and the **Starting Strength** of that unit rises to match.

detail.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

join.recipient: one other friendly unit being led by a CRYPTEK model
